data.body: OPERATOR CHOSE (a): accept AC5 as amended. Recorded as a comment on 84c7 naming the three options presented and the one taken, and AC5 was rewritten in the description to state what the seven runs establish - criterion FIRES on a real hand-enumerated plan at validity 1.0 naming the LSP-invisible string-literal site; the move is proven APPLICABLE for its trigger set and silent otherwise; the selection limitation is documented rather than presented as met - with the original wording and the reason it is unachievable kept inline so the narrowing is auditable. The amendment narrows the claim, it does not widen it. Editing the description invalidated the plan-review attestation, so the CLOSE gate demanded a fresh review ('stale-material: the plan was materially edited since review'); that review is running, after which B closes and then the epic.
